data.title: 尤贝尔 · 黑森林宅邸的花嫁试探
data.description: 【森林边缘旧宅·薄暮】尤贝尔穿着黑色婚纱靠在藤蔓拱门旁，绿发侧马尾被头纱轻轻压住；她没有按仪式站直，而是伸手拨弄捧花里的小刀形叶片，用半睁的紫瞳向镜头露出像在提问的笑。
data.action: 藤蔓拱门旁拨弄捧花里的叶片，头纱压住侧马尾，半睁紫瞳试探回眸
data.mood: 危险好奇心里的花嫁反差
data.promptProse: Übel from Frieren: Beyond Journey's End wears a black long-sleeved bridal gown with a translucent veil, green embroidery and a wildflower bouquet. She leans against the overgrown arch instead of following the ceremonial posture, turning a wildflower between her fingers as if testing it. Her side ponytail slips beneath the veil, and her half-lidded purple eyes study the viewer with a teasing question while fireflies gather in the darkening garden. violet twilight with firefly pinpoints.
